The 2023 BMW X5 M Base is a high-performance luxury SUV that balances everyday comfort with advanced technology and track-inspired engineering.

This SUV is ideal for drivers who want a sophisticated blend of athleticism, comfort, and versatility. The X5 M's advanced adaptive suspension and all-wheel drive system help it manage challenging weather and road conditions, which is especially valuable for families or professionals facing variable climates such as those in the Midwest. Inside, the Extended Merino Leather Seat Upholstery, multi-zone automatic climate control, and premium harman/kardon speakers provide a refined, connected, and comfortable cabin experience. Those researching high-value performance SUVs will find its technology, premium materials, and spaciousness fit a wide range of lifestyles, from daily commutes to long road trips.

Driving the X5 M brings a balanced mix of raw power and refined control. The 4.4L V8 TwinPower Turbo engine delivers instant acceleration, while the 8-speed automatic sport transmission shifts smoothly and responds quickly to driver input. Adaptive suspension and four-wheel independent suspension systems help the SUV remain composed on corners and uneven surfaces, translating to a confident feel in both urban and highway driving. Speed-sensing steering and a sport steering wheel enhance feedback and engagement, making routine commutes or spirited weekend drives equally enjoyable. The integrated all-wheel drive system ensures dependable traction in wet or snowy conditions.

Safety is a central focus of this SUV, with the Driving Assistance Professional Package adding critical technologies that support driver awareness and accident avoidance. Features such as adaptive cruise control, electronic stability control, and a comprehensive suite of airbags-including knee, dual front, and side impact airbags-work together to protect occupants. The exterior parking camera, heads-up display, and rain-sensing wipers improve visibility and situational awareness in busy parking lots or inclement weather. Automatic high-beam headlights and brake assist further help drivers manage nighttime conditions and sudden stops, promoting peace of mind in daily driving.

The X5 M comes equipped with a suite of luxury and convenience features designed to enhance both driver and passenger experience. Standout amenities include the Navigation System, power moonroof, heated front seats and steering wheel, memory seats, and Connected Package Pro for integrated digital services. The auto-leveling suspension and auto-dimming mirrors contribute to stress-free highway cruising.

Among luxury performance SUVs, the X5 M stands out for its blend of power, technology, and refinement. Compared to rivals like the Mercedes-AMG GLE 63 S and Porsche Cayenne Turbo, the X5 M offers distinctive styling and a comprehensive list of standard features.

What are the key features of this vehicle? The X5 M delivers luxury appointments such as Extended Merino Leather seats, heated front seats, harman/kardon audio, and a Navigation System. How does it perform in daily driving? The V8 engine and adaptive suspension ensure responsive acceleration and composed handling for both city and highway use.

To experience the 2023 BMW X5 M Base firsthand, visit Dave Sinclair Ford at 7466 S Lindbergh Blvd, St. Louis, MO 63125 or call . Their team can guide you through the features, answer any questions, and help you make a confident, informed decision about this high-performance luxury SUV.

One Owner, Pampered and Pristine 2015 Fiat 500 Sport

Welcome to the cleanest, exceptionally maintained, most loved Fiat 500 you'll find!

A small car with big heart and personality, the Fiat 500 returned to the US in 2011. For 2015, the Sport gained a 7-inch TFT display and Bluetooth streaming audio. A stiffer suspension and sport-tuned steering let you deftly navigate traffic or throw it around the twisties on the way to Evergreen or Estes Park.

The 1.4-liter 4-cylinder averages 32 mpg, so it sips instead of guzzles. If you want to fit in six kids and all their soccer equipment, this is not your ride. But if you prefer style, zip, panache, and living simply, this is the car for you! Just shy of 50,000 original miles, this Verde Azzuro gem has never missed an oil change or service date. The clutch pedal recall was done in 2016. This summer it got a full inspection, air filter, spark plugs, fuel system cleaning, brake fluid flush, and alignment. Add in a March 2026 oil change, Interstate battery in 2025, and windshield in 2021. All paperwork is in a binder, including original owner's manual and more.

16 Sport rims with wheel locks
2nd set of steel winter rims with low mileage (20k) winter tires, and a second set of lug nuts appropriate for the rims
WeatherTech mats front and back
Never has been in any accident or fender bender, ever. Carfax provided in service binder
5-speed manual, shifts smoothly and provides a very sporty driving experience

The leather interior is excellent, not a crack in sight. This Fiat has spent nearly every day of its life safely garaged.

Detailing before photos revealed a minor scuff in the lower driver's rear quarter panel wheel well.

While the current owner has loved this Fiat 500 since purchased new, it is time for a new steward to enjoy and maintain this exceptional example going forward. Will it be you?

Motivated by a TurboCharged 6.7 Liter High Output PowerStroke Diesel V8 producing 500hp and 1200lb-ft of torque to a 10 Speed Automatic transmission. That lets our Four Wheel Drive truck tow, haul, and take on your world without breaking a sweat. A mighty grille helps you make a bold impression with Ford F-350 details like LED lighting, fog lamps, power running boards, a twin-panel sunroof, a power tailgate, a Pro Power Onboard generator, and striking alloy wheels.

Ford's Platinum cabin sets the standard for modern luxury with heated/ventilated leather power front seats, heated rear seats, a heated leather power steering wheel, dual-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable pedals, and a power sliding rear window. Advanced technology leads the way with a 12-inch touchscreen, a 12-inch driver display, connected navigation compatibility, wireless charging, WiFi® capability, wireless Apple CarPlay® and Android Auto®, voice recognition, and the premium B&O® Unleashed sound system for exceptional clarity on every drive.

Ford doesn't make you sacrifice safety for strength, supplying front/rear automatic braking, a head-up display, trailer-compatible blind-spot monitoring, lane-keeping assistance, a 360-degree camera system, trailer reverse guidance, trailer-sway control, and other intelligent features. With all that, our F-350 Platinum earns the Super Duty seal of approval! Save this Page and Call for Availability. We Know You Will Enjoy Your Corwin Ford Tri-City Test Drive Towards Ownership!

A free Carfax vehicle history report is available on all used . Corwin Ford of Tri-Cities proudly serves the Pasco, Kennewick, and Richland area with quality new and used vehicles. Family owned for over 100 years. All prices plus applicable sales tax and licensing. A negotiable documentary service fee up to $200 may be added to sales price or capitalized cost of the vehicle. Pricing may not include $399 Pulse or $399 Corwin Connect fee. One vehicle unless otherwise noted and subject to prior sale without notice. While supplies last. EPA mileage estimates are for newly manufactured vehicles only. Your actual mileage will vary depending on how you drive and maintain your vehicle.

Balance of Factory Warranty! 2023 Land Rover Range Rover SE LWB Silver
The Range Rover SE Long Wheelbase stands as a benchmark of modern luxury, blending timeless British design with extraordinary capability and an expansive cabin layout. Its commanding profile features smooth, flush surfaces, seamless glass, and clean horizontal lines that emphasize its long-wheelbase proportions. Designed to deliver an effortless sense of presence, this flagship luxury SUV provides an unmatched balance of sophisticated road manners and refined power.

Performance
Engineered to deliver smooth, potent acceleration, the Range Rover SE LWB features an advanced powertrain paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission and intelligent all-wheel drive. Electronic air suspension continuously adapts to road conditions, creating the signature floating ride quality Range Rover is renowned for. All-wheel steering enhances stability at highway speeds while drastically reducing the turning radius, making maneuvering in tight urban settings effortlessly agile. Terrain Response technology automatically optimizes vehicle settings across varying surfaces, ensuring supreme confidence off the road or through challenging weather conditions.

Design
Exuding understated modernism, the exterior is highlighted by striking black-finished alloy wheels that create a sharp, athletic contrast against the bodywork. Deployable power running boards extend smoothly upon opening the doors, offering elegant ingress and egress before stowing flush into the rocker panels to preserve aerodynamic efficiency. Inside, the extended wheelbase transforms the cabin into an ultra-spacious retreat, delivering exceptional legroom for rear passengers. Exceptional craftsmanship shows throughout, from the leather-appointed seating to carefully curated trim finishes and ambient interior lighting.

Technology
At the heart of the cabin is the Pivi Pro infotainment system, accessed through a curved glass touchscreen with haptic feedback. A fully digital interactive driver display projects essential driving information directly in front of the driver, complemented by dynamic navigation, wireless smartphone integration, and high-fidelity Meridian audio sound. The onboard Technology Package adds cutting-edge innovations, including a head-up display that projects speed and turn-by-turn navigation onto the windshield, as well as a Clear Sight interior rearview mirror that uses a rear-mounted camera feed to provide an unobstructed view behind the vehicle even when cargo or passengers block the rear window.

Advanced Safety Features
A comprehensive suite of driver assistance systems provides constant peace of mind. Standard technology includes adaptive cruise control with steering assist, active lane keep assistance, blind spot monitoring, and rear cross traffic alert. Emergency braking detects potential collision risks ahead, while a surround camera system offers an interactive view around the vehicle to simplify tight parking maneuvers.

Convenience and Comfort
Passenger comfort is prioritized in every detail. Multi-zone climate control keeps the cabin at individual ideal temperatures, while power-adjustable seats offer multi-stage heating for total cold-weather comfort. The heated steering wheel provides immediate warmth to the driver's hands during chilly mornings, seamlessly integrating with the vehicle's winter comfort amenities. A power upper and lower split tailgate allows for effortless cargo loading, completing an interior environment designed around seamless luxury and daily usability.

The integrated Advanced Trailering System simplifies towing setup, and the available camera systems give you clear visibility from multiple angles.

The Z71 Off-Road Package elevates capability with off-road tuned suspension, skid plate protection, and chrome grille inserts. Whether you're tackling rough terrain or preparing for specialized work, the Snow Plow Prep/Camper Package offers a higher-output alternator and essential mounting provisions. The Gooseneck/5th Wheel Package includes the Chevytec spray-on bedliner and strategically positioned camera mounts for enhanced utility.

Inside, the crew cab proves remarkably well-appointed. Heated steering wheel, panoramic sunroof, and multiple power outlets throughout create a comfortable working environment. The technology platform connects seamlessly via Bluetooth and wireless charging, while the infotainment system keeps you informed with navigation, entertainment, and vehicle diagnostics at your fingertips.

This Silverado 2500HD has been maintained and represents an outstanding opportunity to own a premium heavy-duty truck with extensive factory packages already installed. The combination of genuine capability, intelligent design, and genuine equipment makes this truck ready for serious work or recreation immediately.

We invite you to examine this truck in person and experience its solid construction and feature-rich environment firsthand. Contact us today to schedule a convenient time to visit the showroom.

description:
This 2024 GMC Sierra 1500 Elevation in striking red combines capable performance with refined comfort for drivers who demand both utility and quality.

The Elevation trim delivers a comprehensive package of features designed for modern truck ownership:
- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability
- Premium Bose 7-speaker sound system with SiriusXM and wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- 20 in. high gloss black painted aluminum wheels
- Heated driver and front outboard passenger seating
- 10-way power driver seat with lumbar support
- HD surround vision camera system with rear cross traffic braking
- Adaptive cruise control with lane keep assist and lane departure warning
- Automatic emergency braking with front pedestrian braking
- Integrated trailer brake controller with hitch guidance and hitch view
- Spray-on pickup bedliner with GMC logo
- Wireless charging and dual USB-C charging ports

Under the hood, the 5.3L V8 delivers solid performance with 15 city MPG and 19 highway MPG. The 10-speed automatic ensures smooth power delivery and responsive acceleration whether you're navigating city streets or highway driving. The 4WD system provides confident traction in varying conditions, supported by electronic stability control and traction management.

Inside the cabin, you'll find a thoughtfully designed space that balances work-ready durability with everyday comfort. The cloth seat trim with heated front seating keeps you comfortable in cold weather, while the 10-way power driver seat with lumbar support allows you to find your ideal driving position. The leather-appointed steering wheel features integrated audio controls for convenient operation. You'll appreciate the genuine wood dashboard insert, which adds a touch of refinement to the interior.

Technology integration makes every drive more connected. The GMC infotainment system features wireless CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, keeping your smartphone functions accessible without distraction. Navigation is available for precise route planning, while the Wi-Fi hotspot capability keeps passengers connected. Safety technology works behind the scenes with automatic emergency braking, lane keep assist with departure warning, and rear pedestrian detection to help protect you and your passengers.

The Elevation package is designed to be genuinely useful. The spray-on bedliner protects your truck bed from daily wear, while integrated trailering provisions including the trailer camera system, hitch view, and integrated trailer brake controller make towing straightforward and safe. Power door locks and keyless entry with push button start add convenience to daily operation.

This Sierra 1500 Elevation represents a solid choice for buyers seeking a full-size truck with modern capability and comfort at a reasonable value. With just over 10,000 miles, it's virtually new and ready for years of reliable service.
